user.title: Connect to a CamStack hub
user.description: Enter the address of your CamStack hub and an account it will accept. The sidebar panel and the Lovelace card use this same address.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the hub.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this off if the hub uses a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with CamStack
reauth_confirm.description: Enter an account the hub will accept. Until it has one, this entry serves the sidebar panel but creates no entities.

data_description.host: Confirm the hub address. It was derived from the URL your panel was already using and may point at a reverse proxy rather than at the hub itself.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this off if the hub uses a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the hub at that address and port.
error.invalid_auth: The hub rejected those credentials. Accounts protected by two-factor authentication cannot be used here.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

init.title: CamStack panel
init.description: The sidebar panel and the Lovelace card follow the hub address you configured. Override it only if your browser reaches the hub at a different address than Home Assistant does.

data_description.panel_icon: Any Material Design Icons name, for example mdi:cctv.
data_description.panel_url: Leave empty to use the configured hub address.
